from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, subprocess, time

root = Path('/home/dev/Projects/starshine-mb')
base = root / '.tmp/dae2-subsecond-20261018/final'
binary = base.parent / 'baseline.exe'
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
expected = '36ed7a42b703da1543bfd64dd41a3c06eef8ae212a500bf4b2b5736b5b6cbed4'
assert sha(binary) == expected
out = base / 'genvalid-baseline-replay'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
lanes = json.loads((base / 'genvalid/execution.json').read_text())
assert len(lanes) == 4 and all(r['exit'] == 0 and r['summary']['comparedCount'] == 10000 for r in lanes)
report = {'baseline_cli_sha256': expected, 'scope': 'Every retained generated residual with a raw Starshine output; exact pre-edit CLI byte comparison does not close Binaryen parity gaps.', 'lanes': [], 'complete': False}
for lane in lanes:
    label = lane['lane']
    summary = lane['summary']
    target = out / label
    target.mkdir()
    row = {'lane': label, 'cases': [], 'unread': []}
    report['lanes'].append(row)
    for folder in sorted((base / 'genvalid' / label / 'failures').glob('*')):
        source = folder / 'input.wasm'
        candidate = folder / 'starshine.raw.wasm'
        if not source.is_file() or not candidate.is_file():
            row['unread'].append(str(folder))
            continue
        metadata = json.loads((folder / 'failure-metadata.json').read_text())
        assert metadata['replay']['passFlags'] == summary['passFlags']
        output = target / (folder.name + '.wasm')
        args = [str(binary), '--compiler-facts=' + summary['compilerFactsPolicy'], *summary['optimizerFlags'], *summary['passFlags'], '--out', str(output), str(source)]
        before = sha(source)
        started = time.time()
        with (target / (folder.name + '.stdout')).open('w') as so, (target / (folder.name + '.stderr')).open('w') as se:
            result = subprocess.run(args, cwd=root, stdout=so, stderr=se, timeout=120)
        item = {'case': folder.name, 'command': args, 'started': started, 'finished': time.time(), 'exit': result.returncode, 'input_sha256': before, 'candidate_raw_sha256': sha(candidate)}
        assert sha(source) == before
        item['baseline_output_sha256'] = sha(output) if output.exists() else None
        item['raw_bytes_equal'] = result.returncode == 0 and output.exists() and output.read_bytes() == candidate.read_bytes()
        row['cases'].append(item)
        (out / 'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
    assert not row['unread'] and len(row['cases']) == summary['mismatchArtifactsPersistedCount'], (label, 'retained artifact coverage incomplete', len(row['cases']), summary['mismatchArtifactsPersistedCount'])
    print(label, 'replayed', len(row['cases']), 'unread', len(row['unread']), 'different', sum(not x['raw_bytes_equal'] for x in row['cases']), flush=True)
assert sha(binary) == expected
report['complete'] = True
report['all_retained_raw_outputs_equal'] = all(not r['unread'] and all(c['raw_bytes_equal'] for c in r['cases']) for r in report['lanes'])
(out / 'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
assert report['all_retained_raw_outputs_equal'], 'Inspect retained baseline differences or unread evidence.'
